tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgrub pa bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dngos grub kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

sgrub pa bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dngos grub kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kun gdod nas spros dang rab bral kun tu bzang mo 'dus ma byas// de yi rang rtsal sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan dpal chen che mchog khrag 'thung rgyal// gcig min du ma'ang 'di na ma yin rang rang blo ngor chu zla bzhin// 'gog pa med par 'char mdzad rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'dud// 'dir dbang thob cing dam la gnas pas bde 'dus che 'bring chung gsum gang yang rung ba'i cho ga yan lag tshang ba'i sgo nas bsnyen sgrub thems shing drod tshad thob pa'i sngags pas las rab 'byams bsgrub pa'i phyir phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga lag tu blang ba la gsum/ sta gon/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sta gon la gnyis/ sa sta gon dang sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i sta gon no// dang po la sa brtag pa ni/ sgrub chen dang khro bo rol pa'i gtor zlog sogs dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe sa brtag mi dgos par dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor zhi ba/ lhor rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du drag po'i las bya dgos la/ de min pa'i glo bur las sgrub kyi tshe sa gzhi rang bzhin gyis dkar zhing 'jam pa/ dbyibs zlum po/ sngon chad rgyal bas zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa/ bkra shis shing yid du 'ong ba'i sa grong khyer la sogs pa'i shar du zhi ba/ sa gzhi rang bzhin gyis ser zhing brjid chags pa/ dbyibs gru bzhi pa dang rgyal po'i pho brang sogs su rgyas pa/ sa gzhi rang bzhin gyis dmar zhing dbyibs zla gam can nam/ tshong 'dus sam/ smad 'tshong ma'i khyim sogs su dbang*/ sa gzhi rang bzhin gyis gnag cing rtsub pa/ dbyibs gru gsum mam/ g.yul bkye pa'i shul lam/ bshan pa'i khyim sogs su drag po bya/ gzhan yang bye bral byas pa'i shul du dbye ba/

yul bud pa'i shul du bskrad pa/ lkugs pa'i khyim du rmongs pa/ zha bo'i khyim du rengs pa sogs rig pa'i mdas bsnun la bya'o// sa bslang ba ni/ mngon pa rgyal po dang sa de'i bdag po sogs la rin bcal zhing tshig gis bslang*/ mi mngon pa la bslang ba ni/ gang du bya ba'i gnas der gzhi dkar po'i steng du tshom bu gcig bkod/ mdun du mchod pa dang dkar gtor bshams la/ skabs 'di nas bzung ste bka' brgyad kyi las byang dang 'don cha bsre dgos pa rnams rang rang gi lugs kyi las byang gi skabs so so nas drangs dgos pa la/ 'dir ni rig 'dzin chen po shī la ka ras mdzad pa'i bde 'dus 'bring po'i las byang sngon 'gro don bdun dang*/ dngos gzhi don brgyad mar sbyar ba yin pas tshul 'dis las byang gzhan la'ang sre shes par gyis shig /oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ rang nyid la thim par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gyis zhe sdang rdo rje gsal gdab/ mdun gyi tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la buṃ las sa'i lha mo gser btso ma lta bu zhi 'dzum phyag g.yas khas len gyi phyag rgya dang g.yon gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis bkang pa bsnams pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang ldan par gyur| rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dmar skya g.yas tho ba dang g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa spros pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba spyan drangs dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ slar dbang gi lha spyan drangs dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ mchod pa dang gtor ma spyi 'gro ltar byin brlabs/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs btags pa gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/

oṃ/ sa yi lha mo chen mo ni// rin chen gser gyi mdog can ma// sna tshogs rin chen rgyan 'chang ma// do shal rkang gdub sgra 'byin ma// 'byung ba kun gyi yum gyur ma| |skyob pa shākya seng ge yi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang gyur ltar// deng 'dir sngags 'chang bdag nyid kyang*// mi mthun dpung las rgyal ba'i phyir// bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sbyin sreg gi// las brtsam de yi dkyil 'khor ni// bri ba'i sa 'di bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ sa'i lha mos rig pa 'dzin pa khyod ci dga' bar byos shig ces gnang ba byin nas sa gzhi de nyid du thim par gyur par bsam/ mchod gtor gshegs/ slar cha gsum gtor ma las byang gi sngon 'gro ltar btang ngo*// sa sbyang ba la sngags kyis sbyong ba ni/ yungs kar dang chu la drag sngags so bdun pa bzlas la gtor/ bya bas sbyong ba ni gzhi de nyid nas stegs bu 'dang ba'i sa bskos la/ rdo dang*/ phub ma/ rus pa/ sol ba/ shing la sogs pa lhad dang ro thams cad dbyung zhing zhib par byas la phung por spung ngo*// gzung ba ni/ langs nas rdor dril dang bcas pa'i rnam lnga 'dod kor dang phyogs mtshams kun tu sdigs mdzub gtad cing*/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid las kyi he ru kaḥ zhes pa nas/ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar nga ro drag pos brjod cing gzhi la g.yas su bskor ba lan gsum bya/ sa bsrung ba ni/ mi rus sam/ lcags sam/ seng ldeng gi phur pa bcu la rang rang gi sngags btab pa'i yungs kar dang dar mthing nag gi cod pan mgul du btags/ khro bo bcur mnga' gsol/ phur gdan bcu la phyogs skyong bcu'i gzugs bris pa mdun du bkram la/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas// khro rgyal ṭak+ki rā dza spros// zhes pa nas/ bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar brjod nas/ slar| in+d+ra ye ti ra baṃ/ zhes dbang po shar du bkod/

de bzhin du/ ag+na ye me lha shar lho/ ya ma ye gshin rje lho/ nai ṛ t+ya srin po lho nub/ wā ru ṇa ye chu bdag nub/ wa ya be rlung lha nub byang*/ ku be ra ye gnod sbyin byang*/ i sha na ye bgegs byang shar/ sūr+ya tsan+d+ra nyi zla shar gyi shar/ pṛ thi wī bh+yaḥti ra baṃ gyis sa lha nub kyi nub tu bkod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ces pas phyogs skyong bcu bkug gzugs so sor bstim/ slar phur bu thogs la/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas// phyogs skyong bcu yi gdan steng du// zhes pa nas/ brlag par bya// zhes pa'i bar brjod nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra sogs kyis hūm̐ ka ra shar gyis shar du btab/ de bzhin du/ bi dza yas rnam rgyal shar/ nī la daṇ+ḍas dbyug sngon shar lho/ ya mān+ta kas gshin rje lho/ ar+yā a tsa las mi g.yo ba lho nub/ ha ya grī bas rta mgrin nub/ a pa ra dzi tas 'dod rgyal nub byang*/ a mṛ tas 'khyil pa byang*/ trai lokyas khams gsum byang shar/ ma hā ba las stobs can nub kyi nub rnams su rang rang gi sngags sham bu dang bcas pa las byang gi sngon 'gro ltar re re brjod pa dang*/ phur bu re re phyogs ma 'chol bar phur khung so sor btab/ mtshams gcod gzhan rnams spro na bya mi spro na mi dgos so// gnyis pa sbyin sreg gi sta gon la bzhi/ rdzas 'du bya ba/ thab dang dkyil 'khor bca' ba/ rdzas bsham pa/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa rnams so// dang po rdzas 'du bya ba la gnyis/ sreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas gnyis so// dang po sreg rdzas ni/ zhi ba la lcang skya'am/ bal bu sogs 'o ma can gyi shing gi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba'i yam shing srid sor bcu gnyis pa/ sboms su mthe'u chung dang mnyam pa/ rtse mo pad+ma kha phye ba'i dbyibs dang rtsa ba mnyam par bcad pa rtsa rtse 'o ma dang mar sbrang rtsir bsnyugs shing sked par ga pur sogs dri bzang dkar pos sbags pa/ rgyas pa'i yam shing star ga sogs me tog ser po can 'bras bur ldan pa'i shing sked pa'i cha las byung ba srid du khru gang*/

sboms su 'chang gang ba rtsa rtse mar dang zho dang 'o mas byugs shing sked par gur gum sogs dri ser pos sbags pa/ dbang la tsan dan dmar po 'dzo mo shing sogs kha dog dmar po can nam/ yang na tsher ma lcags kyu lta bu yod pa'i rtsa ba'i cha las byung ba'i srid du sor brgyad pa/ sboms su mthe'u chung gi phyed dang mnyam pa rtsa rtse pho mo'i dri chu dang bu ram gyis byugs shing sked par gi waṃ sogs dri dmar pos byugs pa/ de gsum ka lo ma dang shun par bcas shing rlan dang ma bral ba phra sbom rnying lci 'khyog rul skam gas rmas pa sogs kyi skyon dang bral ba sha stag go// drag po la dug shing ro bsregs pa'i 'gal dum mam/ dur khrod kyi shing tsher ma can gyi rtsa ba'i cha las byung ba srid sor bcu/ sboms su srin lag dang mnyam pa bkas pa/ dbyibs gru gsum pa rtse mo gnyis rnon por bzhog pa rlan shun dang bral ba/ rtse mo dug khrag dang zhun chen sked par dri nga ba kha dog nag po byugs pa/ zhi rgyas la mar dkar gyi mar khu las kyi kha dog bsgyur ba/ dbang la til mar kha dog dmar po byas pa/ drag po la mi rta khyi nya phag gi rkang tshil tsha ba'i til mar dang bsres pa/ gzhan yang zhi ba la spos dkar/ thang chu/ tsan+dan dkar po'i rigs ci 'dzom/ rgyas pa la sih+la/ spos shel/ me tog ser po ji snyed pa/ dbang la gur gum/ tsan+dan dmar po/ sin+dhu ra/ li khri/ me tog dmar po ji snyed pa/ dbang gi dgug pa la tsan+dan dmar po'i byang bu mtho gang ba la/ gang dbang du bya ba'i gzugs dang ming rus 'dod gsol bris pa/ drag po la gu gul/ zi ra dkar nag /yungs dkar nag /lcags phye/ zangs phye/ mi rus kyi phye ma'i me tog nag po ji snyed pa/ rnga bong gi sbangs dang*/ phub ma/ mi rus kyi phye ma/ bong bu'i chu dang dug khrag gis sbrus pa'i liṅga 'khyud gang bar ra dug dang*/ da dhu ra dang*/ btsan dug gis byugs pa'i nang dug shog la liṅga ming rus dang tha mar drag sngags so bdun pa dmod sham btags pa dang*/

dzaḥkhram mgo phyir bstan gyis bskor ba dug khrag dang dmigs bya'i dri ma'i zag pa bcug pa dang*/ bgegs la'ang de'i liṅga la gnod byed ngos zin na de gnas pa'i bag rdul chu shing dang*/ ngos ma zin na rlung 'dre 'tshub byas shul gyi sas sbags pa bcug /dgra bgegs gang yin yang lcags slang nang du phung re'i gdan la mnan pa byed na mnan 'khor bcer ba'i steng du bsad 'khor kha yar bstan/ steng du drag po las brgyad 'dus pa'i 'khor lo dang rtsibs drug sbyangs pa'i 'khor lo kha sbyar/ de'i steng nas mtshon cha can gyi 'khor lo kha sbubs pa'i steng du gong gi nya bo gan rkyal du bzhag /steng nas phung res bkab rdo rje dang phur bu sogs kyis mnan la bzhag /dbye ba la bya rog dang 'ug sgro la so so'i ming rus bris pa dang bsgrub bya gnyis rgyab sprad 'thab 'dzing bya tshul gyi liṅga la khong par ming rus ngan shags dmod pa bris pa/ bskrad pa la sprang dbyug gi byang bu la ming rus dang rlung dkyil gzhu lta bu'i steng du bsgrub bya'i liṅga dang*/ gzhu mchog la ba dan btsugs pa lag gis 'jus pa ming rus dmod sham bris pa/ reng ba la sa dkyil gyi dbus su liṅga bris pa dang zha bo'i gos dum la ming rus bris pa/ rmongs pa la lug gi khong par liṅga bris pa dang*/ lkugs pa'i gos dum la ming rus bris pa rnams/ 'jam gsum la dar ram/ ras kyi gos zung las mthun gyi kha dog can/ drag po la ro ras sam/ phung re'am/ zhing lpags/ 'jam gsum la ku sha sngon po rtsa rtse'am lo ma ma nyams pa dang*/ drag po la ro skra/ so rtsi 'jam gsum la mngar gsum/ a ru ra/ su pa ri lha min khrag rnams sbyar ba dang*/ drag po la de steng rdo thal bsnan pa/ dung zhal lam bum par bsang chu ku sha'i chun por btsugs par 'khyil pa dang*/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags bzlas pa/ zhi ba la bram ze'i rgyun bzhag gi me'am dge 'dun gyi tshang mang gi me/

rgyas pa la nags la me mched pa'i me'am me shel las byung ba/ dbang la gar mkhan nam/ smad 'tshong ma'am/ mgron po'i me'am/ tshong 'dus kyi me'am/ sprang pos lam du bus pa'i me/ drag po la yug sa'am bshan pa'i me/ me snod ni las mthun/ sbar shing ni zhi ba la 'o ma can gyi shing la bram ze'i ras dkar pos dkris pa/ rgyas pa la rgyal po'i lag gi ras ser po/ dbang la smad 'tshong ma'i lag gi ras dmar po/ drag po la ro ras kyis dkris pa/ zhi rgyas la mar dkar/ dbang la til mar/ drag po la zhun chen gyis sbags pa/ rlung g.yab las mthun gyi dbyibs dang kha dog can/ zhi ba la 'o mas sbrus pa'i gtor ma/ rgyas pa la mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i gtor ma/ dbang la zhos sbrus pa'i gtor ma/ drag po la dug khrag gis sbrus pa'i gtor ma rnams las mthun gyi kha dog dang ba dan gyis brgyan pa/ de yang 'das lha la dpal gtor dang me lhar 'jam gsum la zlum po dang*/ drag po la gru gsum pa rnams so// las bzhi thun mong du nas/ gro/ 'bras/ sran ma rnams shun pa dang sa rdo phub ma sogs med cing ma grug pa/ so ba shun pa dang ma bral ba/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis sbrus pa'i zas mchog /dūrba'i myu gu sngon po/ ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba lo mar ldan pa/ shing thog sna tshogs pa/ til nag yungs kar rnams so// gnyis pa mchod rdzas ni/ 'jam gsum la til nag 'bras dkar ku sha rnams sbyar ba'i mchod yon/ dri bzang po 'o ma dang sbyar ba'i zhabs bsil| 'o ma dang 'bras phyes sbags pa'i zhal bsil/ dri bzang dang ku sha dang spags pa'i mthor 'thung*/ las mthun gyi kha dog can gyi me tog /zhi ba la spos dkar ga pur tsan+dan dkar po sogs kyi bdug spos/ rgyas pa la a ga ru ser po/ sih+la 'bras dkar sbyar ba'i spos/ dbang la a ga ru nag po/ gur gum dza ti la sogs sbyar ba'i spos/ zhi rgyas la mar dkar gyi snang gsal/ dbang la til mar dri bzang sna tshogs sbyar ba'i dri chab/

dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis sbrus pa'i lha bshos/ drag po la dug khrag gi mchod yon/ chang gi zhabs bsil/ khrag chen gyi zhal bsil/ dug chu'i bsang gtor/ dbang po lnga dang dug gi me tog sngon po dri nga ba dang*/ dri med pa'i me tog /gu gul sha chen sgog skya rnga bong gi sbangs dang sbyar ba'i spos/ mkhris chen chang dang sbyar ba'i dri chab/ 'bru nag sha khrag rus pa'i zhal zas/ de rnams kyi snod kyang zhi ba la dngul/ dung*/ nya phyis/ shel dkar/ rgyas pa la gser dang ra gan/ dbang la zangs dmar/ drag po la thod phor ram rdza snod tshal pa'o// gnyis pa thabs dang dkyil 'khor bca' ba ni/ sa chog zin pa'i sa rnams 'jam gsum la dri bzang gi chu dang*/ drag po la dug chus sbrus la stegs bu gru bzhi pa thab kyi rgya tshad las phyi rol du rkang gang tsam re lhag pa'i rgya la dpangs bskum mkhyid gang ba me long ltar ngos 'jam por byas par bris thab byed na thig chen brgyad btab/ zhi ba la lte ba nas rgyang mtho re zlum por bskor ba khru gang gi thab kyi nang gi tshad/ de'i phyir sor mo bzhi mu ran dang*/ de'i phyir sor bzhi kha khyer bskor ba'i phyir sor mo bzhi dor ba'i stegs bu'i thig gru bzhir btab/ thab nang du pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar po dang*/ kha khyer la rdo rje dkar po'i phreng ba dang*/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje dkar po/ rgyas pa la lte ba nas khru re gzhal bar thig gru bzhir btab pa nang gi rgya tshad/ khru do la phyir mu ran dang*/ de'i phyir kha khyer sor mo brgyad re dang*/ de'i phyir sor mo brgyad dor ba'i stegs bu thig gru bzhir btab pa'i thab khung dbus su pad+ma ser po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar rin po che ser po cha dgu pa'i dbus su hūm̐ ser po dang*/ kha khyer la rin po che ser po'i phreng ba dang*/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rin po che ser po/

dbang la thab kyi nang gi rgya tshad mu ran kha khyer rnams rgya tshad drag po ltar la/ zla gam gyi thig man ngag ltar btab pa'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa lo 'dab dang ldan pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar po dang kha khyer la pad+ma dmar po'i phreng ba dang*/ dbang gi dgug pa la nang gi lte bar lcags kyu'i yu ba pad+mas byas pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar po dang*/ kha khyer la lcags kyu'i phreng ba so phyir bstan pa dang*/ dbang gi grwa bzhir pad+ma zla phyed dmar po dang*/ dgug pa'i grwa bzhir lcags kyu zla phyed dmar po/ drag po la thab khung sor mo nyi shu pa'i rgya tshad gru gsum mnyam par 'ong ba'i thig man ngag ltar btab par/ mu ran dang kha khyer sor mo gsum re dang*/ phyir sor drug dor bar stegs bu'i thig gru bzhi pa/ thab nang du pad+ma nag po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar rdo rje nag po rwa rnam par gdengs pa'i lte bar hūm̐ nag po/ bsad las gtso bor byed na rdo rje mi phyed par ral gri nag po 'chang zung la hūm̐ nag /kha khyer la rdo rje nag po rwa gdengs pa dang ral gri spel ma'i phreng ba nag po/ grwa bzhir rdo rje rwa gdengs pa'am ral gri gang rung zla phyed dang bcas pa nag po bri'o// brko thab byed na thab kyi rgya'i phyed dang mnyam pa'i stegs bu la thur du thab khung bru zhing kha khyer mu ran dang bcas pa gyen du brtsigs pa/ rtsig thab byed na rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang mnyam par brtsig /de gnyis gang la'ang 'jam gsum la kha khyer nang du bag gis gzhol ba can dang drag po la phyir gzhol ba'o// brko ba dang brtsig pa'i thab la nang du pad+ma dang*/ de'i lte ba'i phyag mtshan sa bon sogs 'bri thab kyi skabs bshad pa ltar bkod do// gsum pa rdzas bsham pa ni/ bris thab la zhi ba la dgon pa'i ba glang gi lci ba skam po srog chags med pa rlan dang bral ba/ rgyas pa la rgya shug gam shug pa kham star sogs 'bras bu can gyi shing*/

dbang dang de'i dgug pa la tsan+dan dmar po dang mdzo mo shing dang gzhan yang shing me tog dmar po tsher ma lcags kyu lta bu ro skyur ba'i rigs rnams/ drag po la dug shing dang ro bsregs pa'i 'gal dum dang*/ dur khrod kyi shing tsher ma can sogs la bya/ de rnams gang la yang rlan dang bral ba srog chags med pa thab kyi dbyibs dang mtshungs par kha khyer gyi steng du tshags dam shing sra la brtan par so so'i rgya phyed dang mnyam par brtsigs/ nang du rgyu snga ma lta bus bkang ba'i dbus sam shar lhor me tshang bca'/ brkos brtsigs kyi thab la nang du bud shing dang me tshang gong ltar bca'/ thab 'khor dang bcas pa las mthun gyi kha dog tu bsgyur/ thab kyi stegs bu'i kha las mthun gyi kha dog can gyi me tog bcal du bkram/ slob dpon gyi gdan zhi ba la ku sha'i chun po'i khri/ rgyas pa la rin po che'i khri/ dbang la dar gos dmar po'i 'bol/ drag po la rdo dang shing gi khrir zhing lpags dang gcan gzan gyi pags pa bkab pa/ thab dang slob dpon gyi gdan khri'i bar du me yol la gangs ri'i gzugs bris pa bzhag /'jam gsum la slob dpon gyi g.yas ngos su stegs kyi khar las mthun gyi gzhi g.yogs pa'i khar rdzas rnams la gu gul gyis bdug /'khyil pa dang hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bsangs drag sngags so bdun ma'i mthar zhi ba la swā hā/ rgyas pa la oṃ/ dbang la hoḥhrīḥ drag po la rbad phaṭa: btags pa lan bdun brjod la bshams/ go rim ni/ yam shing mar khu til yungs kar// zas mchog ku sha dūrba nas// gro 'bras sran so 'bru yi tshogs// zhes pa'i go rim ltar mar khu ma gtogs gzhan rnams mang nyung gnyis tshar du bshams pa'i nyung ba gnyis thab ngos me lha'i dang*/ phyi'i mang ma dkyil 'khor pa'i rdzas su bya/ mar khu slob dpon nye logs g.yas zur du bsham/ thams cad la bdud rtsi lnga bran/ slob dpon gyi g.yon ngos su stegs kyi steng las mthun gyi kha dog can gyi ngos gzhi las slob dpon ngos nas mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ 'thor 'thung rnams stegs kyi steng du bshams pa'i so so'i mdun du bzed zhal dang 'thor 'thung la ku sha'i chun po btsug /drag po la rdzas dang chu bzhi slob dpon gyi g.yas g.yon go sa brje/ las bzhi gar slob dpon gyi mdun du nyer spyod lnga po tshar gnyis bshams pa'i thab ngos me lha'i dang slob dpon ngos dkyil 'khor pa'i bya/ de gnyis la rang rang gi zhal zas kyi mthar gos zung dang gtor ma bshams/ de rnams kyi nang rol slob dpon gyi ngos su rdor dril gyi bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba dang*/ ḍā ma ru/ 'khyil pa brgya phrag sogs bzlas pa'i bsang chu/ rlung g.yab/ ku sha/ dpal 'bar/ so rtsi la sogs pa nyer mkho rnams bshams/ slob dpon gyi g.yas sam gang bder bdag bskyed kyi gtor ma/ sman raka/ mchod pa/ tshe'i zla gam/ dza gad/ chad mdo/ brtan skyong gi gtor ma rnams bshams/ dbang gi dgug pa la slob dpon gyi gdan zur du snod dmar po'i nang du tsan+dan gyi byang bu dar ras dmar pos dril ba dang*/ drag po la 'khor lo dang*/ liṅga/ thun/ gdab phur/ mtshon cha/ dur rdo'i gtun khung dang mchong gi a tog gi gtun bu rnams bzhag /gzhan yang dgos pa'i yo byad dang rol mo la sogs pa tshags su tshud par bya'o// bzhi pa bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ zhi ba la srod/ rgyas pa la snga dro/ dbang drag gung gnyis la/ slob dpon gdan gyi steng du 'jam gsum la khrus byas te zhi ba la dkyil 'khor yod na de'i shar sgo dang*/ glo bur ba yin na phyogs can shar du kha bltas gos rgyan dkar po bya/ dri dkar po'i chus lus gsher shing zhi dul ba'i bsam pas pad+ma'i skyil krung gis 'khod/ rgyas pa la byang du phyogs pas gos rgyan dri ser po bzang po'i 'dug stangs tshims shing rang ba'i sems/ dbang dgug gnyis la gos rgyan dri dmar rdo rje skyil krung gis brtse zhing chags pa'i sems/ drag po la gos rgyan dri nag po khrag gis lag par byugs khro bo'i 'dug stangs sam/

rkang pa g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum khro 'khrug gi sems dang ldan pas 'khod la skyabs 'gro nas tshogs kyi bshags pa'i bar sngon 'gro las bdun dang*/ dngos gzhi las brgyad rnams las byang ltar rdzogs par byas/ tshogs la longs mi spyod par bzhag /skabs 'dir 'khor lo dang liṅga rnams la mkhyen gsol nas gtun rdung gi bar nan cher byas la bzhag go// spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la gnyis/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa dang*/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i tshul lo// dang po 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ thog mar lce lag rdor dril byin gyis brlab pa ni/ thal mo ā di kā dis yongs su bkang ba las lag g.yas su nyi ma dang*/ g.yon du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar gyur par dmigs nas rnam lnga 'dod kor bya/ lce hūm̐ las rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur par bsams la/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes snying khar bzung*/ dril bu aḥlas yum rdo rje snyems ma zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hoḥ zhes dku g.yon par bzung*/ slar dril bu smin mtshams su dkrol zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā nā da swa bhā wa/ badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥswā hā/ zhes brjod/ me lha'i mchod pa dang sreg rdzas rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas kyi snod rnams las mthun gyi rgyu dang kha dog can so so'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me tog /bdug sbos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rnam pa las so so dang mthun pa'i mchod rdzas la ngo bo sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin can du gyur/

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā d+yaṃ= ā tsa mā naṃ= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= puṣ+paṃ= dhū paṃ= ā lo kaṃ= gan+dhaṃ= nai wi d+yaṃ= shapad= sbyar bas byin brlabs/ lag gnyis rdor dril dang bcas pa'i khu tshur kha sbyar ba'i gung mo gnyis bsgrengs pa rtse sprad pa sreg rdzas rnams la gtad la/ oṃ swā hā/ zhes pas rdzas rnams bkrus par bsam/ slar phyag rgya de nyid rdzas so sor reg cing*/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ yam shing dang*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ zhun mar/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hā/ 'bru rnams/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes rdzas lhag ma rnams kyi nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs par bsam/ de nas/ stong pa'i ngang las zhun mar la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i rdzas tha dad rang rang gi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing so so'i bya ba byed nus pa'i phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa las dang mthun pa'i kha dog can du gyur zhes dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra sho pa le swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar rdzas sngags 'og nas 'byung ba rnams lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas 'jam gsum la ku sha dang*/ drag po la ro skra thogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes bzlas/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge// tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin| |dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swā hā/ zhes zhi ba la rtse mo shar du thog mar phyogs pa dang*/ de bzhin du/ rgyas pa la byang*/ dbang la nub/ drag po la lhor thog mar rtse mo bstan pas 'jam gsum la g.yas skor dang drag po la g.yon skor du snga ma'i rtsa ba phyi ma'i rtse mos non par bkram/ ku sha'i chun po che ba zhig las mthun gyi phyogs su rtse mo bstan pa ba lang rna ba lta bu thab steng du g.yogs so// de nas las mthun gyi me snod du gnas par/

oṃ ṭak+ki rā dza hūm̐/ dang*/ 'khyil pas bsrung*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs/ rlung g.yab kyis sbar nas dpal 'bar dang*/ 'jam gsum la ku sha dang*/ drag po la ro skra dang lhan cig tu sbar bar bsang chu 'thor zhing 'khyil pa dang*/ nang mchod dang bcas drag sngags so bdun pas 'jam gsum la g.yas skor dang*/ drag po la g.yon skor du bsangs la me bskul bya ba ni/ hūm̐ */ rdo rje ri rab lhun po'i shar lho nas// 'bar ba'i lha chen drang srong brjid pa'i tshul// gang la spyi 'dul ye shes rdo rje'i me// rab tu 'bar zhing 'od kyi phreng ba 'khrugs// gti mug 'joms pa'i me ni smug nag 'bar// zhe snang 'joms pa'i me ni mthing nag 'bar// nga rgyal 'joms pa'i me ni ser nag 'bar// 'dod chags 'joms pa'i me ni dmar nag 'bar// phrag dog 'joms pa'i me ni ljang nag 'bar// nad gdon zhi ba'i me ni dkar la mdzes// tshe dpal rgyas pa'i me ni ser la brjid// khams gsum dbang sdud me ni dmar la 'tsher// drag po sgrol byed me ni nag la rngam// steng gi me lce chad pa 'og tu 'phro// 'og gi me lce chad pa steng du 'phro// shar gyi me lce chad pa nub tu 'phro// lho yi me lce chad pa byang du 'phro// nub kyi me lce chad pa shar du 'phro| |byang gi me lce chad pa lho ru 'phro// shar lho'i me lce chad pa nub byang 'phro// lho nub me lce chad pa byang shar 'phro// nub byang me lce chad pa shar lhor 'phro// byang shar me lce chad pa lho nub 'phro// stong gsum thams cad me yi rang bzhin la// ye shes me yi lha tshogs sprin ltar dkrigs// 'bar ba me yi las rnams deng bsgrub bo// oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes me tshang du bcug /hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐/ zhes rlung g.yab kyis sbar/ 'bar ba na rigs kyi snying po ste zhi ba la/ oṃ bai ro tsa na ya oṃ/ rgyas pa la/ oṃ rat+na swa bhā wa trāṃ/

dbang la/ oṃ a mi tā bha hrīḥ drag po la/ oṃ a mo gha sid+dhi āḥ zhes so sor sbyar ba dang*/ mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis me gso/ cher 'bar ba na thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las dpal chen che mchog he ru ka zhi ba la| sku mdog dkar po/ de bzhin du/ rgyas pa la/ ser po/ dbang la/ dmar po/ drag po la/ mthing nag /zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dpal gyi chas thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i pang du yum gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags bde ba chen por zhu ba las byung ba'i zhes pa las bzhi kar sbyar nas/ zhi ba la/ ye shes kyi thab khung kha dog dkar zhing dbyibs zlum pa/ rgyar khru gang dang zabs su khru phyed pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i kha khyer la rdo rje dkar po'i phreng bas bskor zhing*/ nang du 'khor lo dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje dkar pos spras pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ zhes dang*/ rgyas pa la/ ye shes kyi thab khung kha dog ser zhing dbyibs gru bzhi pa/ rgyar khru do zabs su khru gang ba/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i kha khyer la rin po che ser po'i phreng bas bskor zhing*/ nang du rin po che ser po cha dgu pa la hūm̐ yig ser pos mtshan pa/ stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rin po che ser pos mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ zhes dang*/ dbang la/ ye shes kyi thab khung kha dog dmar zhing dbyibs zla ba bkas pa lta bu/ rgyar sor mo nyi shu dang zabs su sor bcu pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i kha khyer la pad+ma dmar po dang lcags kyu'i phreng bas bskor ba/ nang du pad+ma dmar po la hūm̐ yig dmar pos mtshan pa/ stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed pad+ma dmar pos mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ zhes dang*/ drag po la/

ye shes kyi thab khung sogs kha dog nag cing dbyibs gru gsum pa/ rgyar sor mo nyi shu dang zabs su de'i phyed dang mnyam pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i kha khyer la rdo rje nag po dang ral gri'i phreng bas bskor ba/ nang du rdo rje nag po rwa rnam par gdengs pa'i lte bar hūm̐ nag pos mtshan pa/ stegs bu'i grwa bzhir rdo rje dang ral gri zla phyed nag pos mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ de nas me lha bskyed pa ni/ me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ zur gsum du raṃ yig gis mtshan pa'i dbus su a las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ raṃ yig dang bgrang phreng las skyes pa'i zhi ba'i me lha 'dzin byed zhi zhing dul la byams pa dang snying rje'i nyams can rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dkar po/ zhal lhag ma g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ gos rgyan dkar po bgos shing srad bu dkar po se ral khar thogs pa/ me lce dkar po'i 'od zer stong gis dkrigs shing ra skyes dkar po'i khri la pad+ma'i skyil krung gis gnas pa/ zhes dang*/ rgyas pa'i me lha dbang chen dga' zhing spro la tshims shing rangs pa gzengs bstod pa'i nyams can rtsa zhal dang sku mdog ser po/ zhal lhag ma g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ gos rgyan ser po bgos shing srad bu ser po se ral khar thogs pa/ me lce ser po'i 'od zer stong gis dkrigs shing ra skyes ser po'i khri la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis gnas pa/ zhes dang*/ dbang gi me lha dmar po brtse zhing bcug pa chags pa'i nyams can rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dmar po/ zhal lhag ma g.yas dkar/ g.yon sngo ba/ gos rgyan dmar po bgos shing srad bu dmar pos se ral khar thogs pa/ me lce dmar po'i 'od zer stong gis dkrigs shing ra skyes dmar po'i khri la rdo rje skyil krung gis 'khod pa/

zhes dang*/ drag po'i me lha rlung chen khro zhing 'khrug la rngam zhing rtsub pa/ khams gsum za bar brtson pa'i nyams can zhal dang sku mdog nag po/ zhal lhag ma g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ gos rgyan nag po bgos shing srad bu nag po se ral khar thogs pa/ me lce nag po'i 'od zer stong gis dkrigs shing ra skyes nag po'i khri la g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa/ zhes so so dang*/ de bzhi ga thun mong du/ phyag drug dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis dbyug gu rtse gsum dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ smin ma dang sma ra 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ lto ba 'phyang zhing sha rgyas bongs thung sgeg pa/ snying khar me yi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa mdo rigs kyi mtshan ma la yi ge raṃ gyis spras pa drang srong gi tshogs du mas yongs su bskor bar gyur/ spyan drang ba ni/ me lha dam tshig sems dpa'i snying gar mtshan ma'i raṃ yig de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu shar lhor 'phros pas| rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po tho ba dang lcags kyu thogs pa spros pas shar lho ri rab kyi me mtshams nas me lha ye shes drang srong gi tshogs du mas bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam/ lag g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas g.yas pa'i 'khrig ma nas bzung*/ g.yas rdo rje ku sha dang bcas pa'i mthe bong srin lag gi rtsa bar 'dzugs pa mi 'jigs pa bskyod pa'i rgyas/ oṃ/ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya a dī bya ā bi sha ā bi sha ma hā shrī ye/ ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye swā hā/ oṃ āḥṭak+ki rā dza dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes spyan drangs shing skad cig gis byon pa la/ rang byung chen po bcom ldan 'das// 'dod pa'i dbang phyug 'dod pa ster// me lha las kun sgrub byed pa// 'dir ni gdan la nye bar bzhugs// ku sha ā sa naṃ ku ruḥ

zhes brjod pas ye shes pa'i tshogs thab kyi me mtshams kyi ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs thams cad bskrad par gyur/ oṃ ṭak+ki dang 'khyil pa bzla zhing bsang chu gtor bas bskrad/ de nas/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sat+kā raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis chu bzhi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ dhū paṃ/ a lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ| nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad/ zhes dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ oṃ ag+na ye ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes sman raka dbul/ rdor dril 'dzin pas rnam lnga 'dod kor 'khyud pa'i rgyas/ oṃ āḥṭak+ki rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ hūm̐ gong ma'i mal du/ baṃ dang hoḥbacug pa brjod/ ye shes kyi me lha 'khor bcas me lha dam tshig pa la chu la chu bzhag pa lta bu bcug bzhin du mi 'gyur bar bcing*/ yang dag par mnyes par byas pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ de nas mchod cing bstod pa ni/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya a dī bya ā bi sha ā bi sha ma hā shrī ye/ ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ ar+ghaṃ gyi mal du/ pā d+yaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ zhes chu bzhi dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra puṣ+pe ā hūm̐/ zhes/ shapada'i bar dang*/ gong ltar sman raka gis kyang mchod nas/ hūm̐ */ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyang ba'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa// rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul// nyon mongs bsregs pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyis sprul pa'i thegs pa bcibs// rigs sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gha ṭi bsnams// chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten 'das kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes bstod// dbang du bya ba ni/

rdor dril dang bcas pa'i lag gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa la/ gung mo gnyis bshibs la brkyang*/ de'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gnyis phan tshun rwa'i tshul ltar bkug cing sbyar/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gnyis so so la bsgrengs pa rwa re re ste rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la/ ma hā bhū ta/ dz+wa la dz+wa la ya/ sarba bhasmiṃ ku ru/ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes bsgrags/ me lha rang rang gi dam tshig la gnas par gyur par bsam/ de nas byon zan 'bul ba ni/ lag gnyis rdor dril dang bcas pa'i zhi ba la rdo rje'i khu tshur/ rgyas pa la rin po che'i khu tshur/ dbang la pad+ma'i khu tshur/ drag po la khro bo'i khu tshur gyis g.yon pas dgang gzar mar gyis bkang ba kha gyen du phyogs pa'i steng du/ g.yas pas blugs gzar mar gyis bkang ba kha gyen du phyogs par brtsegs te bzung la/ 'jam gsum la me lha 'dzum pa'i nyams kyis zhal cung zad gdangs pa dang*/ drag po la cher gdangs pa'i ljags la raṃ yig las dang mthun pa'i kha dog can dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la hūm̐ yig las mthun gyi kha dog can 'od 'bar bas mtshan par gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya zhes pa nas/ bā ha na ye swā hā/ zhes sngar bshad pa'i me lha'i sngags ring dang*/ oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes dgang blugs kyi sngags dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes mar gyi sreg blugs kyi sngags rnams sbrel ba brjod cing sngags mthar dgang blugs kha sbyar bas 'jam gsum la g.yas skor dang*/ drag po la g.yon skor du 'bul zhing rol chen yang bya/ slar yang dgang blugs mar gyis bkang ba kha gyen bstan brtsegs te bzung ba sogs gong ma'i tshul kho na lta bus bdun nam gsum 'bul/ de yang sngags mthar/ zhi ba la/ swā hā'i gong du gang zhi bar 'dod pa che ge mo shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes dang*/ rgyas pa la/ gang rgyas par 'dod pa che ge mo bau ṣ+ṭas puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang la/ gang dbang du bya bar 'dod pa che ge mo wa sh+yaṃ ku ru hoḥ dbang gi dgug pa la/ che ge mo ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥhrīṃ/ drag po la/ dgra'am bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ dbye ba la/ che ge mo dang che ge mo gnyis bi dwe sha ya phaṭa/ bskrad pa la/ che ge mo uts+tsha ta ya phaṭa/ reng ba la/ che ge mo'i lus s+t+waṃ bha ya phaṭa/ rmongs pa la/ che ge mo'i sems mo ha ya phaṭa/ ces sbyar/ sham bu 'di rnams ni me lha'i rdzas rnams dang*/ dgang blugs 'bul ba thams cad dang*/ 'das lha'i dgang blugs dang*/ rdzas dang liṅga sogs 'bul sngags thams cad kyi gsham du sbyor shes par byos shig /de ltar phul bas me lha dgyes bzhin du bzhes te bsreg bya 'dzin pa'i dam tshig la gnas nas sreg blugs len cing bdag gi bya ba sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes par gyur to// zhes brjod cing bsam/ skabs 'dir me pra brtag pa ni/ zhi ba'i me mdog dkar zhing 'tsher la dwangs pa/ rtse mo dkar zlum drang por 'bar ba dang*/ rdo rje 'khor lo bum pa dung gdugs| rnga yab nyi zla'i dbyibs dang*/ yig 'bru dang phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa lta bu/ pi wang dang gling bu dung dang bung ba'i skad lta bu shis so// rgyas pa'i me kha dog gser btso ma dang nyi ma'i 'od lta bu la gsal shing sgrib g.yogs med pa dang*/ gur gum gyi me tog lta bu dang*/ rtse mo gru bzhi pa rin po che'i dbyibs lta bu dang*/ dpal be'u rgyal mtshan nor bu khang bzang dar po che phyar ba'i dbyibs dang*/ yig 'bru dang phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa dang*/ 'ur ba dang*/ ldir ba dang*/ rnga dang*/ dung chen dang*/ 'brug gi skad lta bu dbyibs 'bru'i phung por bcur ba lta bu shis so// dbang la kha dog dmar zhing dwangs pa byu ru la til mar byugs pa lta bu dang*/ me'i rtse mo dmar zhing zla gam gyi dbyibs lta bu dang*/

lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog /dril bu/ pad+ma/ dgang blugs la sogs pa'i dbyibs can dang 'khor zhing g.yo ba'i rnam pa lta bu dang*/ sku dang*/ yig 'bru/ phyag mtshan dang*/ lug ru 'khyil ba lta bu dang*/ dri zhim pa dang*/ rdza rnga dang*/ pheg rdob kyi skad dang*/ 'ur ding seng 'khrol glu dbyangs kyi sgra lta bu dang*/ me lce glog gi rnam pa bzhag pa lta bu rnams shis so// drag po la kha dog dmar nag dbyibs khrag gis ral pa bshal ba lta bu dang*/ me'i rtse mo nag cing gru gsum dang*/ dbyibs ci 'dra yang kha dog nag pa dang*/ kham pa dang*/ sprin nag pa lta bu dang*/ mtshon cha gzeng ba lta bu dang*/ sgra skad drag por 'bar ba sogs shis/ las bzhi gar bzang rtags de rnams las go log pa dang*/ dud pa che la 'bar dka' ba dang*/ me lce chad pa dang dud 'gro'i mgo lta bu ngan/ khyad par du kha dog ci 'dra yang bkrag dang 'od snum ma chags pa mthong na mi sdug pa'i rtags/ dud pa sprin nag 'khrigs pa ltar 'dug na shi chad 'byung*/ dud pa shin tu che na grib gnod/ me ji ltar sbar yang 'bar dka' na las mi 'grub/ me lce dum bu chad cing 'phro na bdag gam yon bdag tshe thung*/ nag cing rtsub la 'khyug po dang chad chod du 'bar na dgra 'byung*/ dud 'gro mi sdug pa'i mgo 'dra na mi kha 'byung*/ me'i mdog mi sdug na yul khams mi bde/ ro bsregs pa'i dri lta bu sogs dri mi zhim na nad yams 'byung*/ yar zhing 'tshig na phugs su gdon zhugs/ me 'bar ba'i sgra mi snyan pa byung na bkra mi shis/ me lce ljon shing gi yal ga breg pa 'dra na 'khor dang longs spyod mi 'du/ sgrub pa po rnams dang mi spro zhing 'tshig na dam sel dang nyams grib yod pa'i rtags yin/ gzhan yang sreg rdzas 'tshig pa ha cang myur ches pa dang sngags mkhan mes cher gdung ba yang ngan pa'i ltas yin no// me pra bzang na gzengs bstod/ ngan na me la 'dod rgyal dang 'khyil ba'i sngags brjod cing bsang gtor bya/

drag sngags so bdun pa'i mthar bgegs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas dgang blugs lan bdun 'bul/ bsang gtor byas la me lha'i sngags gsum sbrel nas dgang blugs bdun nam gsum mam gcig 'bul lo// de nas rdzas rnams dbul ba ni/ yam shing zung du byas pa rtse mo lhar phyogs pa/ oṃ badz+ra ya dz+nyā ya/ zhes pa'i mthar/ zhi ba la/ bdag gam sbyin pa'i bdag po'i gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rgyas par/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang la/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa wa sh+yaṃ ku ru hoḥ dbang gi dgug pa la/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dang che ge mo ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥhriṃ'/ drag po spyi la/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ bsad pa la dmigs bsal yod na/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa dang dgra'am bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ dbye ba la/ bar du gcod pa dang che ge mo dang che ge mo bi dwe sha ya phaṭa/ bskrad pa la/ bar du gcod pa la che ge mo uts+tsha ta ya phaṭa/ reng ba la/ bar du gcod pa dang che ge mo'i lus s+t+waṃ bha ya laṃ phaṭa/ rmongs pa la/ che ge mo'i sems mo ha ya phaṭa/ ces so sor sbyar ba ni mar khu phyin gyi rdzas thams cad la bsre'o// mar khu la/ ag+na ye swā hā/ 'byor ba= til la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ sdig pa= yungs kar la/ oṃ sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā/ bgegs= zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ bde ba mchog la= ku sha la/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā/ bsrung ba mchog la= dūrba la/ oṃ badz+ra ā yuḥṣe swā hā/ tshe la= nas la/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ shugs la= gro la/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri swā hā/ nad med pa la= 'bras la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ bsod nams rgyas pa la= sran ma la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ stobs rgyas pa la=

so ba la/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hā nor dang 'bru rgyas pa la= shing thog rnams la/ oṃ badz+ra sho pa le swā hā/ rigs rgyud= sna tshogs ni/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes me lha'i sngags nyid kyis 'bul/ de ltar rdzas rnams kyang nyer gcig re sogs 'bul la/ thams cad grangs mnyam dgos pa yang ma nges te/ dper na tshe 'phel bar 'dod na durba grangs mang du 'bul ba sogs dgos pa skabs don dang yang bstun pa yin no// rdzas sna re re rdzogs mtshams rol chen yang bya'o// de ltar rdzas rnams 'jam gsum la snyan pa'i gdangs dang*/ drag po la nga ro drag pos phul ba'i rjes su/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra ā tsa mā naṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza hūm̐ gis zhabs bsil dang*/ ā tsa mā naṃ gyi mal du/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis bsang gtor byas la/ nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ hūm̐ */ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces zhi ba la'o// rgyas pa la/ 'dzin byed kyi mal du/ dbang chen me lha/ dbang la/ dmar po/ drag po la/ rlung chen zhes spro'o// de nas lag g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas 'jig rten pa'i khu tshur bcang*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sor mo bzhi bsgrengs pa 'bar ba ltar byas pa me lha'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ ag+na ye dzu hu dzu hu swā hā/ zhes brjod pas me lha rab tu tshims shing mnyes par gyur par bsams shing*/ se gol gsum gtogs pas me lha thab kyi nang du me 'bar ba'i rnam pa nyid du gyur to// zhes so// gnyis pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ 'das lha'i mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas rnams bsang sbyang byin rlabs sngar me lha'i skabs ltar ji ltar bshad pa ltar bya/ lha bskyed pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su/ spro na/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las e yaṃ raṃ keṃ bh+rūṃ raṃ ṇaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/

saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ so so'i sa bon rnams rim pa bzhin 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ e las nam mkha' kun tu bzang po'i mkha' dbyings su rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin zhes pa nas/ 'od 'phro zhing 'bar bar gyur gyi bar dang*/ de nas/ bh+rūṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ me ri 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi klong du bh+rūṃ las ye shes 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'ang ye shes lda dang ldan pas phyi rol rin po che sna lnga las grub pa zhes pa nas/ dregs pa pho mo gdan du bting ba'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis 'byung rim gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa bskyed la/ de tsam mi spro na/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon nas e yaṃ nas 'phro zhing 'bar bar gyur zhes pa'i bar gyis 'byung rim rnams dor la/ me ri 'bar ba'i dbus su bh+rūṃ las ye shes 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'ang ye shes lda dang ldan pas phyi rol rin po che sna lnga las grub pa zhes pa nas/ dregs pa pho mo gdan du bting ba'o// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ de nas gzhal yas khang dbus ma'i gdan gyi thog tu hūm̐ mthing nag las rdo rje mthing nag hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal che mchog he ru ka dbu dgu/ phyag bco brgyad/ zhabs brgyad dang ldan pa/ de'ang zhi ba la/ dbus kyi zhal gsum dang sku mdog dkar po/ rgyas pa la/ ser po/ dbang la/ dmar po/ drag po la/ mthing nag /g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis ni dkar zhing bzhad pa dang dmar zhing khro ba'o// zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga bzhugs pa'o// de'i g.yon gyi phyogs su lus dang grib ma'i tshul du yum khro mo gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma zhes pa nas/ yab la stob pa/ rgyan cha lugs yab dang mthun pa'o// rtsibs bzhi la che mchog rigs bzhi yab yum zhes pa nas/ ce spyang ma brgyad la sogs pa'i pho nya rnams so// shar phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen pa'i dbus su ru tra nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la gtso bo bcom ldan 'das badz+ra he ru ka sku mdog dkar po/

zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa/ zhal g.yas mthing*/ g.yon dmar/ dbus sku dang mthun pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa'i pho nya rnams so// lho'i phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su ma he nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la gtso bo bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum/ zhal g.yas ser g.yon dmar dbus sku dang mthun pa nas/ gri ging la sogs pa'i pho nya rnams so// nub phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su klu chen nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la gtso bo bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum/ zhal g.yas dmar g.yon sngo dbus sku dang mthun pa nas/ khams brgya la sogs pa'i pho nya rnams so// byang phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su lha chen nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la gtso bo bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog dkar po| zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus sku dang mthun pa nas/ bcu drug la sogs pa'i pho nya rnams so// shar lho mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su ma mo nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la gtso bo bcom ldan 'das bla med he ru ka zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dmar dbus sku dang mthun pa nas/ ro kha ma la sogs pa'i pho nya rnams so// lho nub mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su rin chen seng khri nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la gtso bo bcom ldan 'das dpal rig 'dzin rdo rje chos rab sku mdog dkar po nas/ sde lnga ma la sogs pa'i pho nya rnams so// nub byang mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su dregs pa nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la gtso bo bcom ldan 'das dpal dregs pa kun 'dus sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum/ zhal g.yas ser g.yon smug dbus sku dang mthun pa nas/

sde brgyad la sogs pa'i pho nya rnams so// byang shar mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor chen por dgra bgegs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la gtso bo bcom ldan 'das dpal stobs ldan nag po zhal gsum dang sku mdog dkar po/ phyag drug dang po gnyis rdo rje dung khrag nas/ pho nya rnams so// dkyil 'khor chen po dgu'i khyams chen gyi phyogs bzhir dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ zhes pa nas/ zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa'o| |zhes pa'i bar las byang dngos gzhi ltar bya'o// rgyas pa la/ che mchog /dbus zhal gsum dang sku mdog ser po/ yang dag /dbus zhal dang sku mdog ser/ g.yas sngo g.yon dmar/ gshin rje rang so/ rta mgrin/ dbus zhal dang sku mdog ser/ g.yas dmar g.yon sngo/ phur pa/ dbus zhal dang sku mdog ser/ g.yas ljang g.yon dmar/ ma mo/ rtsa zhal dang sku mdog ser/ g.yas sngo g.yon dmar/ rig 'dzin/ sku dang zhal ser/ mchod bstod/ sku dang rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas sngo g.yon smug /drag sngags/ zhal gsum dang sku mdog ser po/ dbang la/ che mchog /dbus zhal gsum dang sku mdog dmar/ yang dag /rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dmar/ g.yas dkar g.yon sngo/ gshin rje/ dbus zhal dang sku mdog dmar/ g.yas dkar g.yon ser/ rta mgrin rang so/ phur pa/ rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dmar/ g.yas dkar g.yon ljang*/ ma mo/ rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dmar/ g.yas dkar g.yon sngo/ rig 'dzin/ sku dang zhal dmar mo/ mchod bstod/ sku dang rtsa zhal dmar/ g.yas ser g.yon sngo/ drag sngags/ sku dang zhal gsum dmar po/ drag po la/ che mchog /yang dag /ma mo/ mchod bstod/ drag sngags rnams rang so/ gshin rje/ rtsa zhal dang sku mdog nag po/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ rta mgrin/ rtsa zhal dang sku mdog nag po/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ rig 'dzin/ sku mdog dang zhal nag por bsgyur ba yin no// de nas las bzhi po gang yin yang*/ de ltar gyur pa'i dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po zhes pa nas/

byon nas bzhugs par mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i bar dang*/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs su gsol ba/ phyag 'tshal rnams las byang dngos gzhi ltar byas rjes/ dkyil 'khor dgu po'i gtso bo rnams kyi thugs kar nyi zla'i gdan la hūm̐ yig las mthun gyi kha dog can gyi mthar rang rang gi sngags las kyi kha dog can gyis bskor ba las spro ba dang bsdu bas rnal 'byor gyi las gang yin thogs med du sgrub par gyur par dmigs te/ gtso bo dgu'i sngags rnams dang*/ drag sngags so bdun pa'ang ci 'grub bzla'o// spro na/ skabs 'dir 'dzab bstod kyang bya'o// de nas byon zan dbul ba ni/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje las mthun gyi kha dog can la raṃ yig las dang mthun pa'i mdog can 'od 'bar ba dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la hūm̐ yig las mthun gyi kha dog can gsal bar gyur par bsams la/ dgang blugs mar gyis bkang ba 'dzin tshul sogs sngar me lha'i byon zan skabs ltar byas la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes dgang blugs gsum mam bdun 'jam gsum la g.yas skor dang*/ drag por g.yon skor du 'bul/ de nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka pra wa ra sat+kā raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ mchod yon dang*| ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lnga dang rol mo 'bul/ slar bdud rtsi sman mchod dngos grub blang ba dang bcas pa/ phyag rgya gar mchod kyang las byang dngos gzhi ltar dang*/ bde gshegs sku lnga mas bstod/ rdzas 'bul ba ni/ che mchog la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka badz+ra ya dz+nyā ya/ spel tshig thams cad gong gi me lha'i skabs ltar bsgyur zhing shing thog dang sha sna tshogs pa'i bar brgya phrag sogs 'bul/

yang dag la/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo badz+ra ya dz+nyā ya sogs nas sha sna tshogs kyi bar/ gshin rje la/ oṃ badz+ra a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza badz+ra ya dz+nyā ya sogs nas sha sna tshogs kyi bar/ rta mgrin la/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra ma hā kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu badz+ra ya dz+nyā ya sogs nas sha sna tshogs kyi bar/ phur pa la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ badz+ra ya dz+nyā ya sogs nas sha sna tshogs kyi bar/ ma mo la/ oṃ gu h+ya dz+nyā na shrī he ru ka gu h+ya dz+nyā na kro dhī shwa rī s+t+waṃ ma ma yo gi nī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo badz+ra ya dz+nyā ya sogs nas sha sna tshogs bar/ rig 'dzin la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi badz+ra ya dz+nyā ya sogs nas sha sna tshogs bar/ mchod bstod la/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ badz+ra ya dz+nyā ya sogs nas sha sna tshogs kyi bar/ drag sngags la/ oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ badz+ra ya dz+nyā ya sogs nas sha sna tshogs kyi bar che mchog grangs kyi phyed re dkyil 'khor brgyad po so sor dbul/ bka' sdod la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā yak+ṣa sa ma ya badz+ra ya dz+nyā ya sogs nas sha sna tshogs kyi bar phyogs mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor gcig gi grangs kyi tshad tsam 'bul/ de thams cad la sha sna tshogs ni lha'i sngags kho nas 'bul/ 'dod gsol thams cad me lha'i skabs ltar bya/ lhag par 'jam gsum gyi rdzas khyad par ba ni lha sngags la 'dod gsol btags pa kho nas dbul/ dbang gi dgug pa'i byang bu ni/ rang gang 'dod de bkug la bdag gi dbang du 'dus par bsams pas byang bu dang de'i dri ma sbags pas 'bul/ drag po la ni/ 'khor lo dang liṅga rnams la gdab las don brgyad ma tshar gcig byas rjes 'khor lo rnams lag g.yas pas 'bul ba'i tshul gyis las byang dngos gzhi'i tshogs bar pa'i bsgral las kyi bstab pa rnams dang*/ yab gcig dpal chen sha la sogs rdzogs par bton la mnan 'khor yod na logs su bzhag

/'khor lo dang nya bo dmigs bya pho yin na rkang pa g.yas dang*/ mo yin na g.yon nas mi bsad pa'i mtshon chas gtub cing dum bu re dang*/ drag po'i rdzas khyad par ba rnams sbrags la drag sngags so bdun pa'i dz+wa la raṃ gyi mthar dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya rbad phaṭa dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes dbul zhing drag po'i nga ro dang rol mo drag tu bya'o| |dbye bskrad rmongs reng rnams gang byed kyang de dag gi rdzas rnams sngags dang bcas pas skabs 'dir bsreg go// 'das lha'i rdzas rnams phul zin pa'i tshe lhag ma cung zad re 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i rdzas kyi steng du blugs la snod rnams kha sbub bo// phrin las bzhi so so'i las 'chol gyi dmigs pa ni/ las bzhi po gang yin gyi rdzas khyad par ba phul zin pa'i rjes 'dir bya ste/ zhi ba la/ gtso bo dgu'i thugs ka nas rnam snang dang bud+dha he ru ka dkar po shin tu zhi ba/ gos rgyan dang 'od zer dkar po can phyag na 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba la gnas la spros/ de'i 'od kyis zhi ba'i lha tshogs dkar po nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs ba'i phyag na zla ba chu shel kyi bum pa bdud rtsi dkar pos gang ba 'dzin pa rnams kyis bdag gam yon bdag la dbang bskur bas gang zhi bar 'dod pa rnams zhi bar byas par bsam/ rgyas pa la/ gtso bo rnams kyi thugs ka nas rin 'byung rat+na he ru ka ser po sku shin tu rgyas pa/ dgyes tshim rangs pa'i nyams can pad+ma ser po dang zla bar gnas pa yum dang bcas pa/ rgyan gos dang 'od zer ser po can rin po che ser po thogs pa las 'od 'phros pas rgyas pa'i lha tshogs ser po rgyas pa'i nyams can/ nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs pa rnams kyis gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsi rin po ches bkang ba bsnams nas/ de'i chu rgyun gyis bdag gam yon bdag la dbang bskur bas gang rgyas par 'dod pa de rnams ches cher rgyas par byas par bsam/

dbang la/ gtso bo dgu'i thugs ka nas 'od dpag med dang pad+ma he ru ka dmar po shin tu chags la brtse zhing gcugs pa'i nyams can/ pad+ma dmar po dang zla bar gnas pa/ gos rgyan dmar po can yum dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha tshogs dmar po dbang gi nyams can nam mkha' gang ba rnams kyis phyag na byi ru'i bum pa dang lcags kyu bsnams pas/ gang dbang du bya ba de'i snying nas lcags kyus bzung la bdag gi mdun du bkug |slar ut+pal dmar po kha ma bye ba'i mde'u can gyi mdas de'i snying la bsnun cing bum pa'i chu rgyun dmar pos dbang bskur bas bdag gam yon bdag gis dbang du 'dus par bsam/ dbang gi dgug pa la ni/ lha de rnams kyi phyag na dgug bya pho yin na pad+mas mtshan pa'i lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ dgug bya mo yin na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pas dgug bya de'i snying nas lcags kyu bzung*/ ske nas zhags pas khrid la bdag gi mdun du bkug /slar pad+ma dmar po'i mda' ut+pal dmar po kha bye ba'i rnam pa can gyi mde'us mtshan pa dgug bya'i snying la bsnun cing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas dgug bya de nyid bdag la rang dbang med par 'dud cing lus dang dri ma ltar skad cig kyang 'bral dbang med par bsam/ drag po la/ gtso bo dgu'i thugs ka nas don yod grub pa dang karma he ru ka nag po shin tu gtum khro khros pa'i nyams can/ pad+ma nag po dang zla ba la gnas pa yum dang bcas pa/ gos rgyan dang 'od zer nag po can ral gri thogs pa las 'od 'phros pas/ drag po'i lha tshogs nag po drag po'i nyams can nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs pa rnams kyis ral gri dang g.yu'i bum pa bdud rtsi sngon pos gang ba bsnams pas dgra bgegs gang yin pa de bkug /mdun du gal brkyal du bsgyel ba mtshon chas bsgral/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas rnam shes gtso bo'i thugs kar bstim/ sha khrag lha tshogs rnams la bstab par bsam/

dbye ba la/ lha de rnams kyis gzas pa gnyis bkug /kho rang gnyis ngan shags smra bzhin du gcig rta dang gcig ma he'i steng du skyon ma thag rta dang ma he 'thab bzhin par bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas/ 'thab cing 'dzing ba'i ngang nas so sor gyes te bskal pa'i bar du yang mi mdza' bar bsam/ bskrad pa la/ lha de rnams kyis gzas pa bkug /yaṃ las rnga mo'i rgyab tu yaṃ las rlung dkyil zla phyed lta bu'i steng du gzas pa gcer bu skra grol bar bzhag /de'i rgyab nas gshin rje nag po lag na dbyug tho thogs pa mang pos lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i pha mthar 'ded par bsam/ reng ba la/ lha de rnams kyis gzas pa bkug /sa dkyil gyi steng du bzhag nas/ bsgrub bya ser por gyur pa'i steng nas ri rab sa'i dkyil 'khor pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs te mnan pas lus reng bar bsam/ rmongs pa la/ lha de rnams kyis gzas pa bkug /lug gi snying khar bcug pa'i dkyil 'khor za ma tog ltar kha sbyor byas pa'i nang du gnas pas sems rmongs shing 'thib par bsam mo// skabs 'dir las bzhi gang la'ang dngos grub blang ba'i cho ga bya ba ni/ tshe dang zla gam dang*/ dza gad rnams slob dpon gyi lag g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas thogs/ bza' bca' btung ba sna tshogs pa mdun du bshams/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas las mthun gyi kha dog can gyi mda' dar g.yab cing*/ hoḥ mi gnas mi dmigs gdod nas grub pa'i lha// dbus dang phyogs mtshams dkyil 'khor chen po ni// pho brang nyi ma dgu shar gzhal yas na// bde gshegs 'dus pa bka' brgyad rig 'dzin bcas// yab yum sras 'khor pho nya srung ma'i tshogs// sku ni brjid rngam mtshan dpe'i gar dang ldan// gsung ni tshangs dbyangs theg dgu'i chos sgra sgrog /thugs ni gting zab mtha' bral ting 'dzin dang*// yon tan 'dzad med dpag yas mnga' ba'i bdag |phrin las mtha' khyab gang 'dul thabs mkhas can// dpal chen khrag 'thung tshogs kyis deng 'dir ni/

sgrub mchog bdag la mchog gi dngos grub stsol// 'chi med dmar po zla gsang ā yuḥṣe// tshe dbang rig 'dzin dngos grub dus 'dir stsol// mkha' gsang mnyam rol nyi zla rdo rje'i gar// zla gam bde stong zag med dngos grub stsol// brtan g.yo'i bcud bsdus bdud rtsi ra sa yān// dza gad dpa' bo'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol// bza' bca' btung ba mi zad gter gyi mdzod// longs spyod rgya chen dngos grub bstsal tu gsol// zhi rgyas dbang drag gang bsam 'grub pa yi// rnam bzhi las kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// 'gyur med sku yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// 'gag med gsung gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// 'khrul med thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// yon tan dpag yas dngos grub bstsal du gsol// phrin las mthar phyin dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes brjod cing dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams kyi phud cung zad bsdus la mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams la thab khung du 'bul/ de'i lhag ma rnams dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo la longs spyad/ lhag ma cha gsum sogs las byang dngos gzhi'i skabs ltar gtang*/ de nas/ zhi ba la/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ye oṃ/ rgyas pa la/ oṃ rat+na saṃ bha wa trāṃ/ dbang la/ oṃ a mi tā bha hrīḥ drag po la/ oṃ a mo gha sid+dhi āḥ zhes rigs kyi snying po gang yin gyis sreg blugs gsum mam/ bdun nam/ nyer gcig phul bas me cher sbar la/ slar| oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru kaḥ oṃ na maḥsan+ta bud+dhā nāṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems su phul/ bshad ma thag pa ltar rigs kyi bdag po gang yin gyi snying po brjod/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka pra wa ra sat+kā raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ mchod yon dang*/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis bsang gtor/ ā tsa mā naṃ gyis zhal bsil 'bul/ skabs 'dir zhabs bsil mi dgos/

sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra shing*// gang la re ga na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur pa'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra yeswā hā/ zhes gos zung dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu lā ya swā hā/ zhes blugs gzar gyis so rtsi dbul/ hūm̐ */ bdud rtsi bsgrub pa'i snod ni ka pā la// zhes pa nas/ rmad byung mchod pa 'bul gyi bar dang*/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā his sman/ hūm̐ */ nyon mongs 'khor ba bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang*// zhes pa nas/ 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol gyi bar dang*/ oṃ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā his rak+ta dang*/ hūm̐ */ gzhong pa rnam dag chos kyi dbyings kyi snod// ces pa nas/ lha la 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol gyi bar dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba ling+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes gtor ma thab tu 'bul/ phyag byar 'os pa khyed rnams la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag bgyi'o// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra pā da ban+da naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes phyag bya/ hūm̐ */ bde gshegs thams cad mnyam nyid thugs kyi ngang*// zhes pa nas/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa'i bar gyis bstod/ 'dod gsol ni/ hoḥ bcom ldan dpal chen po bde gshegs 'dus pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad rig 'dzin dang bcas pa yab yum sras sprul 'khor bcas ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad bdag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rang gi gsang mtshan che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ mkhyen cing gzigs su gsol/ bdag dang yon bdag yod na yon bdag che ge mos gtso byas pa'i nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bzung da lta'i lus 'di yan chad du/ nyon mongs pa lngas kun nas bslangs pa'i las dang bag chags sdig sgrib nyes ltung mi dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bus 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur cing*|

mtho ris dang thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa la bar du gcod pa'i phyogs ngan pa thams cad skad cig nyid la byang shing dag nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa chen po kun bzang che mchog he ru ka'i go 'phang dam pa dus da lta nyid du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes spyir btang la/ bye brag zhi ba la/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar gcod mi mthun pa'i phyogs ris ngan pa thams cad dang*/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa rnam par 'tshe ba thams cad dang*/ khyad par du'ang gang zhi bar 'dod pa che ge mo zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol/ rgyas pa la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal dang 'byor pa/ longs spyod dang mnga' thang*/ nor dang 'bru/ zas dang gos/ snyan pa dang grags pa la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i phyogs thams cad dang*/ khyad par gang rgyas par 'dod pa che ge mo yar gyi ngo'i zla ba'am/ dbyar dus kyi rgyun 'bab ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ dbang la/ bdag gi bsam pa dang re ba ji bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams kyi lha dang mi'i rgyal po dang btsun mo/ sras dang blon 'bangs| dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ dbang gi dgug pa la/ che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum bdag gi dbang du sdus shig /ces so// drag po la/ bdag gam yon bdag la gnod cing 'tshe la bar du gcod pa'i phyogs ris ngan pa byad phur/ rbod gtong*/ nad mtshon/ byur dang skal pa ngan pa/ than ltas/ rmi lam/ mo ngan mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad thal ba'i rdul du brlag par mdzad du gsol/ bsad pa dang*/ dbye bskrad/ reng rmongs la ni dmod pa drag pos mngon spyod spyi 'gro ltar bya'o// de nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka pra wa ra sat+kā raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ mchod yon 'bul/

me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir| |mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod// ma mnyes yongs su ma shes gang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bya ba gang nongs pa// de kun gtso bos bzod par rigs// ces dang*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥbadz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra hūm̐ muḥ dkyil 'khor pa'i ye shes kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas/ bskyed pa'i dam tshig pa rnams rang nyid kyi srog rtsol nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig tu bdag nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ de nas me lhar gtang rag gi cho ga ni/ oṃ ṭak+ki dang a mṛ tas thab la bsang gtor bya/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes sreg blugs gcig phul bas/ me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam pa las/ slar sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan chas las dang mthun par bzhengs par gyur par bsam| oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod rol mo dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye pra wa ra sat+kā raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ mchod yon dang*/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis bsang gtor/ pā d+yaṃ gyis zhabs bsil/ ā tsa mā naṃ gyis zhal bsil dbul/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos// mi shigs rdo rje'i sku nyid la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul gyi// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye hūm̐ gis gos zung dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu lā ya swā hās so rtsi dbul/ slar/ yaṃ shing nas sha sna tshogs kyi bar lan gsum re kho nas phul bas rdzas lhag ma med par byas la snod rnams rim bzhin kha sbub/

yon bdag gi don du zhi rgyas byed na sbyin bdag gis slob dpon la yon phul te/ de'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong nas slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung gis bzung la/ thab khung la g.yas skor lan gsum byas rjes blugs gzar gyi mgo la g.yon skor du 'jus nas sreg blugs lan bdun 'bul du bcug /sngar dgang blugs kyang 'bul du bcug /'khyil pa bzlas pa'i srung skud zhi ba la dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po me'i dri ma 'gos par byas la/ de'i lag par bcings la ṭak+ki dang 'khyil pas bsang gtor bya/ gtor ma las mthun du byin brlabs/ oṃ ag+na ye a kā ro mu khaṃ gsum gyis phul/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar brjod/ slar zhabs bsil dang*/ bsang gtor dang nyer spyod lngas mchod/ gang yang bdag blo sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang*/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub byed sreg bya za ba gshegs// ji bzhin dus su tshur byon la// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ muḥ me lha ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ se gol lan gsum gtog pa dang*/ me lha dam tshig pa rang gnas su gshegs par bsam/ hoḥ sku lnga lhun grub bde gshegs zhi ba'i sku// zhes pa nas/ thams cad mkhyen thob bkra shis shog /ces pa'i bar las byang ltar shis brjod bya zhing bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab/ long yod na las bzhi ga'i me rang zhir btang*/ long med na zhi ba'i me 'o ma/ rgyas pa la gur gum gyi chu/ dbang la tsan+dan dmar po dang sin+dhu ra'i chu/ drag po la dug khrag gi chus gzhil/ zhi ba'i thal sol dang yig brgya mang du bzlas pa'i chus rang ngam yon bdag khrus byas pa'i khrus chu dang lhan cig rol mo dang bcas pas rgyun 'bab kyi chu bor bskyal/ rgyas pa'i thal sol 'dod don gyi rdzas dang rol mo dang bcas ri bo 'phan bzang gi rtser bskyal/

dbang gi thal sol me tog dmar po dang lhan cig zhib par btags sin+dhu ra dang bcas rlung chen dus rol mo dang bcas ri mthon po'i rtser rlung la 'phyar/ drag po'i thal sol dgra bgegs dmigs bya yod na/ cha gsum byas pa'i cha gcig thun rdzas zor dang bcas lha rnams drag tu bskul zhing dmigs pa'i phyogs su 'phang*/ cha gcig mnan 'khor dang lhan cig thod ngan sogs su mnan chad dang bcas gang 'os su mnan/ cha gcig 'bab chu drag po sde brgyad gnas pa'am ri brag lha 'dre gnas sar bskyal lo// zhi ba'i rjes su yig brgya ci mang bzlas/ rgyas pa'i rjes su tshe gzungs dang nor lha'i gzungs mang du 'don/ dbang gi rjes su dbang sdud kyi gzungs sogs mang du bsgrag /drag po'i rjes su zor dang zlog pa mang du bya/ las bzhi gang yin yang mthar phyin pa'i slad du bka' brgyad kyi tshogs dang bskang ba brgya rtsa dang skong lnga ci 'grub la 'bad cing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya/ gzhan yang sbyin sreg dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ byas pa'i phan yon/ ma byas pa'i skyon/ de dag gi dam tshig phyi nang dang gsang ba de kho na'i sbyin sreg gi rnam bzhag sogs 'chad par shin tu spro na na'ang yi ge'i ngal ba dang gleg bam gyi bongs la 'jigs pas ma spros so// smras pa/ bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud lung nyi shu dang*/ 'brel ba'i man ngag la sogs che phra kun// mthong thos rtogs pas rab 'byams las bsgrub pa'i// sreg chog 'di ni kho bo'i blo nor tsam// la la bde 'dus las byang blor tshud kyang*// khro bo rol pa'i yi ge klog tsam la// bka' brgyad shes rlom can gyi dregs pa dang*// don kun shes pa'i legs bshad 'di mi mnyam// tshig don ma mthong bskyed rdzogs ma bsgom zhing*// bzlas brjod ma thems sngags kyi las sbyor la// smros pas bris nas lag tu len pa dang*// bye ma btsir la mar khu 'dod dang mtshungs// 'bad pas sbyong dang mkhas par ma bslab par// rigs rus cho 'brang 'khor dang longs spyod kyi// dregs pas mdo sngags gzhung shes khas len pa// smyon pa'i gar stabs de la su zhig mgu// don kun shes pas don bzhin brtsams pa 'dis// don gnyer rnams kyi don 'bras kun sgrubs dang*// don gyi snying po don dam kun tu bzang*// don bzhin bsgrubs nas don gyi chos ston shog
